title: Agency Settings
description: Agency identity, access footprint, and managed services.
forbiddenBody: Only agency admins can change agency settings.
footprintDescription: Live counts for this agency. The numbers are read-only — they update as workspaces, members, and content change.
planDescription: Read-only plan limits and live usage counters.
servicesDescription: A quick view of the services your agency relies on. Sensitive credentials are never shown here.
credentialsNote: Credentials are encrypted or deployment-managed and are never shown here.
identityDescription: The shared identity for every workspace in your agency. The slug is the unique identifier used in URLs.
